text: A running key is a long text written under the message, one letter per place. Drawn here: the K1 solution, with the BERLIN alphabet for the message and the CLOCK alphabet for the copper.
The search slides the text one letter at a time along the message, forwards and backwards; three misses among the 24 known places end an offset.
146,932,380 trials over every offset, both directions, every table pair and three modes: no offset comes within two misses.
